readerCopy.body: One signature moves budgets and headlines together like a verdict. A merger, election, succession, or internal takeover places public authority and control of money or information in the same hands. The Sun concentrates attention on the person in charge, while Pluto deepens their control over access and consequence. Under the conjunction, the title and the leverage behind it become one source of power. The consolidation may produce decisive action while leaving fewer people able to challenge the decision or correct the public record.
